text:
Alex: Quick triage — macOS CI started failing after the tokenizers 0.14.0 release during wheel unpack. Also seeing KMS integration tests fail in the same pipeline (cryptography pulled to 40.x). Suspect resolver change + a transient CVE/patch in one of the deps. Filed GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/1234
Mira: Can you paste the failing log lines? which job exactly?
Alex: macos-wheel job. Paste from the runner:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
ERROR: subprocess-exited-with-error
  python setup.py bdist_wheel did not run successfully.
  exit code: 1
```
Also noticed `pip` is resolving `cryptography==40.1.0` which breaks our KMS client binary on the macos runner.
Jordan: Ugh. We've seen `tokenizers` binary tags flip and some manylinux wheels removed. Two quick options: pin tokenizers to 0.13.3 in our constraints, or force a platform-specific wheel build in the CI. Pin is faster for a hotpatch.
Sam: Before pinning — what's the CVE status? Are we chasing a security fix that requires the newer tokenizers? If there's a security advisory we might need to include the fix in a backport instead of pinning older.
Alex: Good call. I checked OSV and GitHub advisory db: tokenizers itself got a low-severity deserialization fix in 0.14.0 (CVE-2026-9999, hypothetical low/medium) but the more severe is in `cryptography` 40.1.0 (CVE-2026-2222) which is medium and affects our KMS path. The CI resolver bumped cryptography when tokenizers wheel failed to install and fallback to a source build pulled a newer resolver behavior.
Liz: TL;DR: cryptography CVE = medium; we should upgrade in prod, but CI breakblocks PR flow. Propose: (1) pin tokenizers to 0.13.3 in the poetry constraints to stabilize CI, (2) open a follow-up to upgrade `cryptography` with KMS smoke tests and coordinated rollout, (3) backport to the 2.x branches if needed.
Mira: Agreed. I can do the PR to pin constraints + regen the lockfile on main. Quick question: do we want `poetry lock --no-update` or regenerate with updated constraints?
Jordan: Use `poetry lock --no-update` after editing pyproject/constraints so we don't accidentally bump other transitive deps. Then run the CI matrix locally with `tox -e macos` if you can.
Mira: I'll open two PRs: one hotpatch to constraints (pin tokenizers==0.13.3 + add `cryptography<40` constraint temporarily) and a second tracked PR to upgrade cryptography and run KMS tests. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4567
Sam: For the security process: create an advisory note with remediation plan and timeline, mark it P2, assign to security-owner. We need to coordinate with infra for KMS test windows. Also record who signs off for backports.
Alex: I'll add the advisory to our vuln tracker and assign to Sam.
Mira: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4568 — includes `poetry.lock` update using `--no-update` and a pinned constraints file. CI is re-running.
infra-bot: CI macos-wheel job restarted by @Mira at 1715002100.
Mira: CI passed on the pinned-poetry-lock run, but the integration matrix still has one failing KMS test in staging due to cryptography ABI mismatch. I've queued a minimal upgrade branch for cryptography + run KMS smoke in staging: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4569
Jordan: For rollout: schedule canary on Dedicated and Private, watch KMS logs and audit events. Add RBAC smoke to the KMS test (create/read/update for service-key role) so we exercise the affected code path.
Sam: Also add an audit-log regression check to Redwood Console e2e to ensure the upgrade doesn't drop audit payloads.
Liz: I'll coordinate rollout windows with infra. Backports: patch to 2.1.x and 2.0.x with the constraint pin, and a tracked upgrade PR that includes the KMS smoke tests + perf check.
Alex: Thanks — next steps summary: 1) hotpatch PIN PR merged (Mira) 2) vuln advisory + ticket created (Alex/Sam) 3) upgrade PR with KMS tests (Mira/Jordan) 4) backports to maintenance branches (Liz) 5) monitor audit/KMS logs during canary ( infra + SRE )
Sam: I'll update the incident tracker and tag security-oncall.
infra-bot: Deploy window reserved for canary: 1715080000 - 1715083600 (requested by Liz).
Mira: Closing the thread here; follow-ups in the PRs. :thumbsup:
